title: Affirmation comes after the context is lost (2026-10-25)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Now, this work cannot be lost because the problems we set up don't get affirmed. 

The current affirmation process still seems to regularly result in lost work. But the time I get to affirmation, context has often been lost, affirmation gets hard and often confused.

Take a look for the narrative affirmation and capture process that should have defined some tier0 records and be informing the next agent editor works
